messages:
Maya: Quick UX pass on the slim create-key modal. Found a few small but frequent friction points after testing with two devs.

Leo: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def456/keys-slim-modal (frames 1-3). Main issues: CTA wording, permission default, and keyboard focus.

Iris: Permission dropdown defaults to `Project:write`. Can we default to `Project:read` and show a short helper: 'Least privilege reduces blast radius.'

Noah: Users misread 'Create & Download' as automatic download. Recommend primary: 'Create key' (reveals secret) and separate 'Download' action in the success UI.

A11yBot: Scan results: warning banner contrast 3.3:1 (fails AA small). Secret reveal missing `aria-live`; SR users won't hear it.

Maya: Small copy proposal: primary 'Create key'; toast 'Key created 12 copy or download now.' Add inline helper under perms: 'This key grants project access 02 choose minimum scope.'

Leo: Tab order bug: after perms, focus jumps to close before reveal toggle. Fix to perms -> reveal -> actions. Add visible focus ring `outline:2px solid var(--focus)`.

Iris: For rotate flow, clarify revocation timing: 'Previous key revoked immediately; recoverable via soft-delete for 14 days.' Link to docs.

Maya: Action owners: Leo (Figma + focus), Iris (copy + docs), Noah (component + toast). I'll file an a11y ticket for contrast & aria-live.

A11yBot: Ticket created: PROD-5901 - 'Slim create-key modal: contrast and aria-live fixes'.

Maya: Thanks team, merge small fixes next sprint if no blockers.
